summary: Martin Marietta Materials filed an 8-K reporting its entry into a Securities Sale Agreement to acquire all outstanding equity interests in Lhoist North America (LNA) from LNA Holding SRL for $13.5 billion total consideration, composed of $7 billion cash and 10,953,543 newly issued shares valued at $6.5 billion (based on VWAP). The board has not yet made a formal 13e-3 recommendation; terms include regulatory condition (HSR) and a $350 million reverse break fee payable if regulatory clearance fails beyond the extended long-stop date of June 15, 2027. Watch for antitrust review duration; risk-arb spread depends on MLM stock price and deal timeline.
